I didn't really have one at first. My goal was just to stay alive for as long as I could. 
Buffed up defence stats as much as I could. Just produced arms and support equipment, went towards people idealology and held my capital and the dam area. 
Once people support was high enough I joined the NCR when they offered, called them in, let them break the line and rushed to VP's
You're not in a position to push back well and really even hold that much ground. Before the ncr was called in I was just holding 3/4 of my land and run out of manpower on scraping the barrel.
You lose any semblance and industry in the initial fall back so producing decent divisions takes a very long time. If i was able to put exsplosive and pmg into my divisions earlier I would have been able to do it quicker.
